terms.meaning: The fraction turned upside down. The reciprocal of 3/4 is 4/3. A fraction times its reciprocal is 1.
Dividing a numerator and a denominator by a common factor before multiplying.

items.name: Whole number × fraction
items.formula: Multiply the numerator by the whole number

items.name: Cancelling first
items.formula: Divide out common factors, then multiply

items.name: Both numbers more than 1
items.formula: The product is more than both

items.name: Both numbers between 0 and 1
items.formula: The product is less than both

items.name: One of each
items.formula: The product lies between the two numbers

items.name: Who gave these rules
items.example: He stated the rules for multiplying and dividing fractions in general form.

mistakes.text: Multiplying does not always make a number bigger. 1/2 × 1/5 = 1/10 is smaller than both.
Turn over the divisor, not the first fraction. 3/4 ÷ 2/5 is 3/4 × 5/2.
Multiply both denominators. Do not keep the denominator as you do in addition. 1/2 × 1/2 = 1/4.
